hooks.command: fsmap hook session-start 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage": "[harness] fsmap is not installed, too old to have `fsmap hook`, or failed: the Rust verification hooks are OFF in this session. Install: cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/d-j-lee/filesystemMap fsmap", "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "[harness] OFF: fsmap is missing, too old or failed, so nothing checks your edits or gates the end of a turn. Before calling a change done, run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test yourself, and tell the user that the harness is not active."}}'
fsmap hook prompt 2>/dev/null || { s=$?; [ $s = 2 ] || [ $s = 127 ] || printf '{"systemMessage":"[harness] fsmap hook prompt failed (exit %s); its check did not run"}\n' $s; }
fsmap hook post-edit 2>/dev/null || { s=$?; [ $s = 2 ] || [ $s = 127 ] || printf '{"systemMessage":"[harness] fsmap hook post-edit failed (exit %s); its check did not run"}\n' $s; }
fsmap hook pre-bash 2>/dev/null || { s=$?; [ $s = 2 ] || [ $s = 127 ] || printf '{"systemMessage":"[harness] fsmap hook pre-bash failed (exit %s); its check did not run"}\n' $s; }
fsmap hook stop 2>/dev/null || { s=$?; [ $s = 2 ] || [ $s = 127 ] || printf '{"systemMessage":"[harness] fsmap hook stop failed (exit %s); its check did not run"}\n' $s; }
